data.text:
Can i get a Goodnight?

It’s been two straight days of being super busy, Christmas season is really starting to hit, and Manila traffic is getting tighter by the hour. 

But just a few more days and I’m off to Japan and Thailand for a much-needed break. Can’t wait for good food, colder weather, and a reset.

Even with the hectic days, I’m still happy because we’re climbing the ranks on both @rainbowdotme and @integra_layer.

Rainbow keeps gaining momentum ahead of the expected TGE next month. New features are rolling out, more traders are joining the platform, and the community growth is nonstop. 
They’re positioning themselves as one of the strongest trading ecosystems heading into 2025.

Integra, meanwhile, continues to stand out with its focused approach to real-world assets. A full-stack Layer 1 built specifically for real estate from execution and compliance to market liquidity. 
They’ve secured strong early backing, and every update feels like they’re lining up for a major Q1 move. The vision is big, but the delivery is even more impressive.

Busy days, heavy traffic, Christmas rush, but the grind is paying off. Still pushing, still ranking, still excited for what’s coming.
